verdict.rationale: Yubico documents a public YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API for fleet delivery, inventory, and shipment management, which covers part of lifecycle tracking. The official ykman CLI offers scriptable per-device configuration (applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots), so bulk configuration is possible through custom scripting rather than a dedicated mass-provisioning tool. Community reports describe replacing or revoking keys as a manual account-by-account process. Missing for 10: any evidence of pre-registration (enrolling keys to users before issuance), a native bulk-configuration workflow, depth on lifecycle tracking beyond a one-line API mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the enterprise fleet features.
